title: Recover a broken release
description: Release 1.1.0 passed its tests and image build but fails at runtime. Inspect the evidence, roll back to the last known-good release, and verify its version and health.

objectives.label: Inspect the failed release logs or container state
Observe the known-good version 1.0.0 from GET /version

hints: Open the Pipeline panel: which stage failed, and what did the verify stage observe?
Read the api logs. The candidate exits during startup, so restarting it cannot help.
Roll back to the last known-good release. Its verify stage probes health and version; you can also probe them yourself.
